BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

8. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

10. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

13. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

15. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   B. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
